title: Catch, self-toss, recatch and deliver
summary: A ball is thrown high into the air when the episode starts and comes down near the robot. Catch it in the shallow cup the Panda holds, which has one open side. Bring the cup to a launch region and toss the ball straight up out of the cup with a real throw: it must leave the cup floor while rising. Move the cup sideways and catch the ball again. Finally, release it into an open box that slides back and forth along a rail, where it must settle while the box is moving.
robot_setup: One Panda, base at (-0.55, 0, 0) facing +x (yaw 0). Its hand carries a shallow square 'toss cup': 0.12 m x 0.12 m inside (2 x `tool_half`), walls 15 mm high (`tool_height`) and 5 mm thick, floor 5 mm thick. The wall on the tool frame's +x side is missing, giving a permanently open pouring lip. The tool frame is the centre of the floor's top surface, z up out of the cup, x towards the open side. A fixed adapter bar connects the closed -x wall to the hand; in the tool frame the hand's TCP is at (-0.12, 0, +0.04), so the cup hangs 12 cm ahead of and 4 cm below the TCP. At the start the cup is level (identity orientation; open side facing world +x), centre at (0.03, -0.15, 0.22).
scene: A small orange ball (radius 12 mm) is thrown upwards and towards the robot at t = 0. It rises high and falls back down near the cup within about the first second. A blue open box (the cart: 0.15 m x 0.15 m inside, 0.06 m deep) is the moving link of a straight rail along the world's y axis. It is driven back and forth the whole episode, slowly, and slowest where it turns around. There are no other objects. The table top is the world's z = 0 plane.
scene_privileged: Ball: radius `radius` (0.012 m), mass `object_mass` (0.035 kg), restitution `restitution` (0.1), friction 0.2. At t = 0 it is at (0.05 + `incoming_speed` x `preview`, y0, 0.39) = (0.2775, y0, 0.39) with velocity (-`incoming_speed`, 0, (0.22 + 0.028 + `radius` - 0.39 + 4.905 x `preview`^2) / `preview`) = (-0.35, 0, about 2.988) m/s. Its ballistic path peaks at about z = 0.845 m (t = 0.30 s) and passes through (0.05, y0, 0.248 + `radius`) = (0.05, y0, 0.26) at t = `preview` (0.65 s). y0 ~ U(-0.07, -0.03) is drawn at reset (first draw). Cart: moving link of a prismatic fixture whose rail origin is (0.23, -0.15, 0.08), axis +y, limits +-0.5 m. It is an open box (inner half 0.075, walls 0.06 m, 5 mm thick) whose floor's top surface is the link origin (z = 0.08 at the rail origin), mass 0.3 kg. At reset it is placed at q0 ~ U(-0.03, 0.03) (second draw) with velocity `fixture_speed`. It is then driven (PD, kp 80, kd 8, at most 8 N) to the target q0 + 0.20 sin((`fixture_speed`/0.20) t), with target velocity `fixture_speed` cos((`fixture_speed`/0.20) t). That is an oscillation of 0.20 m amplitude with peak speed `fixture_speed` (0.04 m/s) and period 2 pi x 0.20 / `fixture_speed` = 31.4 s. It reverses at t = 7.85 s (q of about q0 + 0.20) and at t = 23.6 s (q of about q0 - 0.20). Its speed exceeds 0.02 m/s only while |cos| > 0.5: t < 5.2 s and 10.5 s < t < 20.9 s within the 25 s horizon (confirmed in an idle run). Cup: `tool_half` 0.06, `tool_height` 0.015, `tool_mass` 0.2 kg, `tool_friction` 0.3, restitution 0.05. Table friction `table_friction` (0.08). The launch region (0.30, -0.10, 0.30) is fixed.

phases.name: initial_catch
phases.text: The ball first flies free (touching nothing) for at least 25 ms. It then enters the cup from above: its centre crosses downwards through the plane `tool_height` + `radius` = 0.027 m above the cup floor (cup frame) while within `tool_half` - `radius` = 0.048 m of the cup centre in both x and y of the cup frame. After that entry the ball stays in the cup for 0.18 s without interruption. In the cup frame this means: |x| and |y| < `tool_half` - 0.45 x `radius` = 0.0546 m; centre between `radius` - 4 mm = 0.008 m and `tool_height` - 0.12 x `radius` = 0.01356 m above the floor; touched by the cup within the last 25 ms; speed relative to the cup (at the ball's position) < 0.09 m/s.

phases.name: launch_region
phases.text: The cup's tool frame comes within 2.5 cm of the launch point (0.30, -0.10, 0.30). The ball is not checked here. The cup position at that moment is recorded as the launch height.

phases.name: self_toss
phases.text: All of the following, in this phase. (a) At some step the ball moves upwards faster than 0.2 m/s with its centre more than 0.06 m above the cup height recorded in launch_region. (b) A separation from the cup floor. On a step where the ball touches nothing, within 0.06 s after its last contact with the cup, and with its centre less than `radius` + 12 mm = 0.024 m above the cup floor (cup frame), three things hold. The ball rises faster than 0.2 m/s in the world. Its velocity relative to the cup floor (at the ball's position) along the cup's z axis is more than 0.03 m/s away from the floor. The cup's z axis is within 0.35 rad of vertical. (c) The ball then touches nothing (neither the cup nor anything else) from that separation on. Any contact cancels the separation and a new one is needed. At least 0.06 s after the separation, with (a) already recorded, the ball's centre is more than `tool_height` + `radius` = 0.027 m above the cup floor, both in the cup frame and in world height above the tool frame's origin. The cup position at the separation is recorded.

phases.name: displaced_recatch
phases.text: The cup catches the ball again by the same test as initial_catch: a fresh downward entry through the 0.027 m plane within 0.048 m of centre after at least 25 ms of free flight, then retention in the cup for 0.18 s without interruption. At a step where this catch holds, the cup's tool frame is more than 3 cm horizontally (in world x-y) from its position at the toss separation.

phases.name: moving_receiver_delivery
phases.text: The ball rests in the cart. In the cart's frame: |x| and |y| < 0.075 - 0.45 x `radius` = 0.0696 m; centre between 0.008 m and 0.06 - 0.12 x `radius` = 0.05856 m above the cart floor; touched by the cart within the last 25 ms; speed relative to the cart < 0.09 m/s. At the same time the ball does not touch the cup and the cart moves faster than 0.02 m/s, for 0.7 s without interruption. This completes the task.

contact_rules: Only the cup may touch the ball, and the cup may touch nothing but the ball: not the cart, its rail or base, and not the table. No other part of the robot (fingers, hand, links, base) may touch anything, including the ball.
world_goals_fixed: Launch point (0.30, -0.10, 0.30) for the cup's tool frame, radius 2.5 cm. It is kept in the task flags as `launch_region` and is not exported as a goal_* observation.
world_goals_seeded: `goal_target` = the point (0.05, y0, 0.22) under the ball's crossing point, announced at reset. It reveals the ball's seeded y0, so it is privileged mode only.
difficulty_note: The ball falls from high up into a cup only 15 mm deep with an open side. The self-toss needs a genuine throw, with the cup accelerating downwards away from the ball while nearly level. The recatch must happen with the cup displaced, and the final release must land in an oscillating box during one of its fast stretches.
standard_notes: The ball is already in the air at t = 0 and comes down within about the first second, so watch it in short steps. The cart moves back and forth the whole time and is too slow for the last phase near its turning points. When the delivery can succeed therefore depends on how long the earlier phases took.
